title: Escape a Large Maze
summary: On a 1 million by 1 million grid, determine if it's possible to move from the start point to the target point without passing through any blocked squares, and without leaving the grid.
statement: On a 1 million by 1 million grid, determine if it's possible to move from the start point to the target point without passing through any blocked squares, and without leaving the grid. Only north, east, south, or west moves are allowed.
constraints: Coordinates lie in a million-square grid and blocked contains at most 200 cells.
Return whether source and target can connect without blocked cells.
hints: At most b blocked cells can enclose at most b(b-1)/2 reachable cells.
Bounded BFS from both endpoints stops after exceeding that enclosure limit.
Succeed when each endpoint reaches the other or proves it is not enclosed.
If neither endpoint is enclosed, the vast remaining grid connects their open regions.
editorial: If neither endpoint is enclosed, the vast remaining grid connects their open regions.

tests.explanation: The two blocked neighbors trap the corner source.
With no blocked cells the endpoints connect.
